tagline: Poctivá kuchyňa z pece na drevo | Rodinné oslavy a svadby do 40 hostí

brand_identity.concept: Warm artisanal Slovak culinary experience centered on wood-fired flame & craft cooking.
brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Elegantly welcoming, rustic-refined, poetic Slovak prose celebrating fire, salt, flour, and traditional hospitality.
brand_identity.target_audience: Gourmets, families celebrating milestones, couples looking for boutique intimate wedding venues (up to 40 guests).

usage_rules.backgrounds: Cream (#F5EFE6) as default light surface, Dark Green (#2F4A3A) for hero, dark cards, footer, and spotlight sections.
usage_rules.accents: Terracotta (#B5532F) strictly for primary action buttons, hover highlights, active badges, and warm fire cues.
usage_rules.text: Dark Charcoal (#1A2620) on Cream backgrounds; Cream (#F5EFE6) / Soft Warm Gray (#E8DFD3) on Dark Green backgrounds.
usage_rules.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#2F4A3A]/80 or bg-[#F5EFE6]/85 with 1px border-white/20 or border-[#2F4A3A]/10.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight font-serif
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight
scale.caption_label: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium font-sans opacity-90

pages_structure.title: Úvod (Home)
sections: Hero with kinetic masked text, video/photo flame backdrop, reservation CTA & view menu button
Philosophical intro: Oheň, Soľ & Čas (Fire, Salt & Time)
Dnešný výber šéfkuchára (Chef's Daily Highlight teaser)
Boutique Eventy & Svadby showcase (up to 40 guests)
Slow Editorial Marquee banner
Hostia o nás (Customer testimonials carousel)
Quick reservation trigger block

pages_structure.title: Denné menu (Daily Lunch Menu)
sections: Header with current week date range & printable/download note
Tabbed day selector (Pondelok - Piatok) with current day autoselected
Daily soup + main dish options with allergen tags & prices
Special chef's lunch dessert addon
Takeaway ordering notice

pages_structure.title: Celé menu (À la carte Menu)
sections: Category navigation sticky bar (Predjedlá, Polievky, Hlavné jedlá z pece, Špeciality, Dezerty, Nápoje & Víno)
Interactive filter (Mäsové, Vegetariánske, Bezlepkové)
Detailed dishes cards with ingredients, pairings, prices in EUR
Somelier wine pairings modal / tooltip
Wood-fired oven process badge on highlighted items

pages_structure.title: Eventy & Svadby (Private Events & Intimate Weddings)
sections: Atmospheric hero (Kapacita do 40 osôb)
Event Packages breakdown (Rodinné oslavy, Malá svadba, Firemná večera)
3D/Photo spatial seating & decor preview grid
Interactive Event Inquiry Form (Nezáväzný dopyt) with guest count, date, package selection, and instant success confirmation

pages_structure.title: O nás (About Us & Craft)
sections: Priebeh remesla: Od kvásku po drevo (Our philosophy)
Náš tím & majster pece (Our chef & team profiles)
Lokálni dodávatelia (Local Slovak farmers & suppliers map/grid)
Photo mosaic of our brick oven built in 1928

pages_structure.title: Galéria (Photo Gallery)
sections: Filterable masonry gallery (Všetko, Jedlá z pece, Interiér & Atmosféra, Oslavy & Svadby)
Full-screen Lightbox with caption storytelling

pages_structure.title: Kontakt (Contact & Map)
sections: Otváracie hodiny (Opening hours card)
Interactive styled Map / Address in Pezinok / Malé Karpaty region
Direct contact card (Telefón, Email, Parkovanie, MHD)
Quick table reservation widget

mobile_first_design.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on buttons and inputs
mobile_first_design.navigation_drawer: Slide-over drawer with full menu routes and quick call button

reservation_modal.demo_behavior: Displays interactive toast & celebratory confirmation card with reference code upon submit without requiring backend database.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered text reveal on load
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Infinite smooth scrolling ribbon using framer-motion or CSS animation
motion_and_interactions.scroll_parallax: Smooth opacity and subtle transform shifts on scroll
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Button press scale (0.98), hover lift (-2px), soft glow on focus

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, links, modals) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.language: 100% Slovak language text across all pages and UI elements.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA standard (Cream text on Dark Green, Dark Charcoal on Cream).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_raw_transparent_headers: Header MUST use backdrop-blur-md with subtle background opacity (bg-[#2F4A3A]/90 or bg-[#F5EFE6]/90) to ensure readability.
